summary: The new serverDailyChallenges entry rule denies every client write and requires authentication for summary reads. Private schedules, attempts and evidence remain under economyPrivate's deny-all rule. Whole-project rules remain prototype/beta because existing social and user-profile access is broader than production should allow. Compilation passed; emulator authorization testing has not run (Java unavailable).

findings.check: New projection authority and update bypass
findings.issue: Static inspection found no overlapping broad allow for serverDailyChallenges or economyPrivate. Anonymous unauthenticated reads are denied; signed-in reads match the DailyChallengeService collection query. All create/update/delete operations are denied regardless of supplied UID, types, fields or ownership. These are reviewed expectations, not emulator results.
findings.recommendation: Before rollout, run owner/non-owner/unauthenticated get/list/create/update/delete, batched-write and private-subcollection tests in the emulator. Ensure only trusted functions write safe entry summaries.

findings.issue: Existing sessions and partyRooms allow signed-in clients to author results and participants. They cannot be used as verified reward authority.
findings.recommendation: Migrate social issuance and finality to a trusted lifecycle before enabling friend/party shared-wallet daily rewards.

findings.issue: Existing users rules permit signed-in reads of full user documents, which can include email. This pass does not resolve that pre-existing exposure.
findings.recommendation: Separate safe public profiles from private account data before broad release.

findings.issue: Authenticated summary queries currently read the day's full collection; callables have instance bounds but no per-account rate limits or App Check enforcement yet.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination, scoped friend/global queries, App Check, per-account limits and operational alerts before enabling at scale.
